review_scope.requested: Scrape recent Situation Room material of framework relevance and log historically useful catalyst context against observed market swings without creating signal authority or noise.

deduplicated_existing_coverage.2026-08-25_through_2026-08-27: Already covered by daily Situation Room owner files and manual review 03_DAILY_CAPTURE_LOGS/catalyst_overlay/situation_room/manual_review/2026/08/2026-08-28_catchup.json; not duplicated here.

review_scope.verification_policy: Situation Room remains discovery/context only. Its interpretations are source claims, not primary-source facts. Market reactions are recorded separately from event descriptions. Temporal overlap must not be read as causal proof.

briefing_crosswalk.headline: Trump rejects Iran June deal, Hormuz reopening stalled
relevant_source_claims: Hormuz reopening remained stalled and Iran-related sanctions/energy risk stayed active.
The briefing described Bitcoin near 80k before a later same-day reversal toward the high-77k area.
The briefing framed the structure as reliant on derivative flows and recent exchange outflows rather than broad conviction.
briefing_crosswalk.market_reaction_note: Repository hourly data independently records BTC above 80k early in the UTC session followed by repeated downside hours. This is consistent with a risk-off/reversal day, but the crosswalk does not attribute the move to Hormuz, sanctions, rates, or any single catalyst.
briefing_crosswalk.learning_note: Useful as a timestamped macro/geopolitical backdrop for the 28-Aug reversal; retain as context, not explanatory certainty.

briefing_crosswalk.headline: Six 2011-2014 wallets moved 553 BTC to non-exchange addresses
relevant_source_claims: Six decade-old wallets moved 553 BTC, mostly to non-exchange addresses.
The briefing explicitly stated that its distribution thesis had proved too early because no adverse one-day price reaction materialized.
The source concluded that dormant-coin transfers were not reliable short-term price signals in this observation.
briefing_crosswalk.market_reaction_note: No causal or predictive market-reaction row is created from the dormant-wallet observation.
briefing_crosswalk.learning_note: Preserve as a negative example against turning dormant-wallet activity into a short-horizon trading signal without independent confirmation.

briefing_crosswalk.headline: Iran sanctions and Gulf strikes cut Hormuz oil flows in half
relevant_source_claims: The briefing described continued Hormuz/energy disruption and tighter Iran sanctions.
It reported a higher-for-longer macro backdrop with US 10Y around 4.72 percent and DXY near 99.7.
It simultaneously described some exchange outflows/holder accumulation.
briefing_crosswalk.market_reaction_note: The combination is historically useful because BTC-specific absorption coexisted with restrictive macro conditions; no single-source direction inference is allowed.
briefing_crosswalk.learning_note: Supports keeping BTC-specific demand/absorption separate from broad risk-on or alt-rotation inference.

briefing_crosswalk.headline: Warsh speech lifts September hike odds to 55-60 percent
relevant_source_claims: The briefing described a hawkish Fed repricing, positive real yields and continued Iran energy risk.
It claimed Binance exchange reserves were at 2026 highs while ETF inflows had cooled.
It also noted that Bitcoin had remained relatively resilient despite the macro/geopolitical pressure.
briefing_crosswalk.market_reaction_note: Repository hourly data independently records BTC trading mainly in the high-77k to high-78k region through the observed morning window. This supports a resilience/consolidation description, not proof that any named catalyst was absorbed.
briefing_crosswalk.learning_note: Important counterexample to one-factor macro narratives: restrictive rates/energy context did not automatically produce an immediate breakdown.

briefing_crosswalk.headline: Warsh speech lifts September hike odds to 60 percent
relevant_source_claims: The briefing maintained the hawkish Fed/rates narrative and described higher yields/dollar pressure.
It repeated high Binance reserve/cooling ETF-flow concerns and MVRV near 1.48.
It highlighted renewed tanker/Hormuz escalation and higher oil.
The live Situation Room dashboard later showed BTC near 78k while bonds/oil remained stressed.
briefing_crosswalk.market_reaction_note: Current framework captures must remain the market-data owner. Situation Room is useful only as catalyst context around the observed consolidation/rotation test. Its BTC, MVRV, exchange-reserve, ETF and macro interpretations do not override canonical owners.
briefing_crosswalk.learning_note: Use to annotate the macro/geopolitical environment around 1-Sep intraday rotation/transmission observations; do not contaminate the rotation evidence itself.

btc_specific_supportive_or_absorption_co: exchange outflow/absorption observations on some days
cross_period_synthesis.historical_market_read: From 25-Aug through 1-Sep, BTC-specific demand/absorption narratives repeatedly coexisted with restrictive macro and energy conditions. The 28-Aug reversal is consistent with a risk-sensitive environment, while 31-Aug through 1-Sep resilience shows that the same macro backdrop did not mechanically dictate immediate price direction.
cross_period_synthesis.rotation_separation_rule: Situation Room context must not be used to confirm ETH leadership, breadth transmission, altseason, entry permission, or portfolio action. Those remain owned by current framework market and rotation evidence.
cross_period_synthesis.negative_learning: The 29-Aug dormant-wallet episode is retained specifically as evidence against over-promoting visually compelling on-chain supply events into short-horizon signals without demonstrated incremental decision value.
